Interactive Summary｜Canine Skull Osteomyelitis CT

顱骨病灶很 aggressive
年輕犬仍要優先想 Osteomyelitis

Seiler et al. 2007：4 隻年輕犬的 skull osteomyelitis。CT 共同 pattern 為 soft tissue thickening + bone lysis + bone proliferation；sequestrum、calvarial destruction 與 meningitis 是最重要的 treatment-changing findings。

4young dogs
3/4bite wound history
2/4calvarial/intracranial extension
2/3treated dogs recurred
Take-home判讀流程Case dataCT patternsRed flagsFiguresClinical use

Take-home Message

Core triad

Soft tissue thickening + bone lysis + bone proliferation。

Main context clue

Young age + trauma/bite wound history。

Main treatment clue

Sequestrum：isolated fragment + hypoattenuating rim。

Main danger

Calvarial/cribriform destruction → meningitis / intracranial spread。

Aggressive CT does not equal neoplasia

Skull osteomyelitis 可造成 moth-eaten bone lysis、large bone defects、spiculated periosteal reaction、soft tissue swelling 與 brain compression，外觀可以非常像 malignant tumor。

快速 CT 判讀流程

  1. Young dog + trauma/bite wound：提高 infection priority。
  2. Bone window：找 lysis、thinning、cortical defects、proliferation、sclerosis。
  3. Soft tissue window：找 swelling、sinus/bulla content、muscle involvement。
  4. 逐區檢查 nasal/frontal bones、calvarium、skull base、zygoma、TMJ、bullae。
  5. 找 sequestrum：dense fragment + hypoattenuating rim。
  6. Calvarium / cribriform plate 受累時使用 IV contrast。
  7. 找 meningeal enhancement、brain compression、midline shift。
  8. 採樣 deep viable tissue + bone，送 histopathology 與完整 cultures。

Case Data

DogAgeTriggerMajor CT phenotype
#17 moSuspected biteWidespread calvarial/skull base lysis, TMJ and bullae involvement, intracranial mass effect
#25 moBiteFrontal bone expansion/destruction, cribriform plate lysis, suspected meningitis
#37 moTraumaChronic frontal thickening, periosteal proliferation, sequestrum
#43 yBiteFocal nasal bone interruption/thinning and mild proliferation
  • Dog #1：S. aureus。
  • Dog #2：S. aureus。
  • Dog #3：S. aureus + S. epidermidis。
  • Dog #4：intracellular cocci on cytology；no culture。
  • Dogs #2–4：surgical curettage。
  • Dog #2/#3：cephalexin 20 mg/kg PO BID × 4 weeks。
  • Dog #3 additionally received enrofloxacin 5 mg/kg PO SID。
  • Dog #2 required repeat curettage after relapse。
  • Dog #2：recurrence after 1 year。
  • Dog #3：recurrence after 3 months。
  • Dog #4：no signs of recurrence at 3 months。
  • Persistent sequestra、biofilm、poor vascular supply and foreign material are plausible causes of recurrence。

CT Pattern Spectrum

Bone lysis

Focal thinning → cortical interruption → moth-eaten destruction → large defects。

Bone proliferation

Mild irregularity → palisading/spiculated → severe thickening/expansion/septation。

Soft tissue

Swelling、sinus fluid、bulla filling、intracranial enhancing tissue。

Joint/ear spread

TMJ erosion and widening；bilateral bulla involvement in widespread disease。

Treatment-changing Red Flags

1. Sequestrum

代表 devitalized bone，可能抵抗 antibiotics。CT 上為 isolated osseous fragment surrounded by hypoattenuating material。

2. Calvarial / cribriform plate destruction

需要擔心 meningitis 或 intracranial infection。此時 contrast-enhanced imaging 非常重要。

3. Multifocal inaccessible disease

Frontal sinus、skull base、TMJ、bullae 多區域同時受累會影響手術規劃與 recurrence risk。

影像圖例｜Figures

Fig. 1 — Extensive skull osteomyelitis with TMJ, bullae, and intracranial mass effect

中文：一隻 7 個月大公 Fila Brasileiro（dog #1）的顱骨橫切面 CT。A–C 為 bone window，D 為 soft tissue window。左側 frontal、temporal 與 parietal bones，以及左側 zygomatic arch 可見廣泛多灶性骨溶解。Calvarium 與 skull base 增厚，並伴隨不規則 spiculated periosteal reactions。A：左側 frontal sinus 部分被液體填滿。B：左側 temporomandibular joint space（黑箭頭）增寬，且關節面被侵蝕。C：雙側 tympanic bullae 壁增厚，並被 soft tissue attenuating material（星號）填滿。D：左側 cerebrum 有明顯 mass effect，包括 midline 向右位移與左側 lateral ventricle 壓縮（白箭頭）。

English: Transverse computed tomography images of the skull of a 7-month-old male Fila Brasileiro (dog #1) in a bone window (A–C) and soft tissue window (D). There is extensive multifocal lysis of the left frontal, temporal, and parietal bone as well as the left zygomatic arch. The calvarium and base of the skull are thickened and have irregular spiculated periosteal reactions. The left frontal sinus is partially filled with fluid (A). The left temporomandibular joint space (black arrow) is widened and the joint surface is eroded (B). Both tympanic bullae are thickened and filled with soft tissue attenuating material (*) (C). In the soft tissue window (D) a mass effect on the left cerebrum is evident as shift of the midline to the right and compression of the left lateral ventricle (white arrow).

Fig. 2 — Focal skull osteomyelitis after a bite wound

中文：一隻 3 歲公 Segugio Italiano（dog #4）的橫切面 CT；病史為先前 bite wound 與 dorsal nasal swelling。鼻樑背側及右側可見 diffuse soft tissue swelling。左側 nasal bone 中斷並伴隨多個 bone fragments，骨緣有不規則 periosteal reaction。Dorsal nasal meatus 內可見少量 soft tissue attenuating material。右側 maxilla 亦有不規則變薄（箭頭）。

English: Transverse computed tomography image of a 3-year-old male Segugio italiano (dog #4) with a history of a previous bite wound and a swelling on the dorsal nasal area. There is diffuse soft tissue swelling on the dorsal and right aspect of the nose. The left nasal bone is interrupted, several bony fragments are present. The borders of the bone have irregular periosteal reaction. A small area of soft tissue attenuating material is present in the dorsal nasal meatus. There is also irregular thinning of the right maxilla (arrows).

Fig. 3 — Frontal bone and cribriform plate osteomyelitis with suspected meningitis

中文：一隻 5 個月大公 German Shepherd（dog #2）的橫切面 CT。A 為 bone window；B 為靜脈顯影劑注射後 soft tissue window。右 frontal sinus 上方有 soft tissue thickening。右 frontal bone 變薄、膨脹，並在多處中斷；cribriform plate 的右背側亦有骨溶解（白箭頭）。Frontal sinus 被 soft tissue attenuating material 填滿。包圍左 frontal sinus 的 frontal bone 增厚且不規則，sinus air space 被 obliterated。造影後右 frontal sinus 內 material 與覆蓋右 frontal lobe 的 meninges 均顯影，並可見輕度 midline 向左位移（黑箭頭）。

English: Transverse computed tomography image of a 5-month-old male German shepherd dog (dog #2) in a bone window (A) and soft tissue window after intravenous contrast medium administration (B). There is soft tissue thickening over the right frontal sinus. The right frontal bone is thinned, expanded, and interrupted in several places. The right dorsal aspect of the cribriform plate is lytic as well (white arrow). The frontal sinus is filled with soft tissue-attenuating material. The frontal bone delineating the left frontal sinus is thickened and irregular, the air space of the sinus is obliterated. There is contrast enhancement of the material within the right frontal sinus as well as the meninges covering the right frontal lobe, and a mild midline shift to the left can be seen (black arrows).

Fig. 4 — Sequestrum and recurrent chronic frontal osteomyelitis

中文：A：一隻 7 個月大母 mixed-breed dog（dog #3）在 head trauma 2 個月後的橫切面 CT。雙側 frontal bones 不規則增厚（左側大於右側），伴 periosteal proliferation 與小型 osteolytic areas；左 frontal bone 上方亦有 soft tissue swelling。左側 thickened frontal bone 內有不規則 bony fragment，周圍被 hypoattenuating material 包圍（白箭頭）；此 sequestrum 後續由手術移除。B：初次就診 3 個月後 follow-up CT。雙側 frontal bones 嚴重增厚，左 frontal bone 內可見 fracture line（黑箭頭），表面並有不規則 periosteal reaction。

English: (A) Transverse computed tomography (CT) image of a 7-month-old female mixed-breed dog (dog #3) presented 2 months after head trauma. Bilateral irregular thickening of the frontal bone (left > right) with periosteal proliferation and small osteolytic areas is seen, there is soft tissue swelling over the left frontal bone present as well. On the left side there is an irregular bony fragment seen within the thickened frontal bone, surrounded by hypoattenuating material (white arrow). A sequestrum was surgically removed. (B) Follow-up CT 3 months after initial presentation. Both frontal bones are severely thickened; a fracture line is now visible in the left frontal bone (black arrow). There is irregular periosteal reaction on the surface of the left frontal bone.

Fig. 5 — One-year recurrence with multilobulated frontal sinus expansion

中文：與 Figure 3 相同的 dog #2，在初次就診 1 年後的橫切面 CT。右 frontal sinus 增大並呈 multilobulated appearance，內部被不顯影的 soft tissue-attenuating material（液體）填滿。Frontal bone 不規則，伴隨 new bone formation 與小型 osteolytic areas。左 frontal sinus 被 obliterated，且 frontal bone 增厚、不規則。

English: Transverse computed tomography image of the same dog as in Fig. 3 (dog #2), 1 year after initial presentation. The right frontal sinus is enlarged with a multilobulated appearance and filled with nonenhancing soft tissue-attenuating material (fluid). The frontal bone is irregular with new bone formation and small areas of osteolysis. The left frontal sinus is obliterated and the frontal bone thickened and irregular.

Clinical Application

Recommended impression

There is an aggressive mixed osteolytic and proliferative skull lesion with associated soft tissue inflammation. Given the young age and history of trauma/bite injury, skull osteomyelitis is a major differential diagnosis despite the aggressive appearance. Neoplasia remains possible. Deep bone and soft tissue sampling for histopathology and aerobic, anaerobic, and fungal cultures is recommended.

Calvarial involvement

若有 calvarial defect、meningeal enhancement、brain compression 或 midline shift，報告應明確指出 suspected intracranial extension / meningitis，而不是只描述 bone lesion。

Bottom line

Young age + trauma/bite history + mixed lytic-proliferative skull lesion = osteomyelitis 必須排在前面。 但影像與 neoplasia 高度重疊，仍需 pathology + culture。
